title: Novig Launches First Prediction Market For Sports Nationally
body_text: Written by: Jacob Fortinsky (Founder & CEO) I’m so excited to announce that Novig, the first prediction market for sports, has launched nationwide! Players have been fed up with having to play on apps where the house always wins and the odds are stacked against them. On Novig, 43% of users are profitable — compared to an industry average of 3% — and we’re the first app to offer a commission-free sports prediction market. We’re absolutely thrilled to now be able to offer our revolutionary app to sports fans nationwide. The Novig app has two modes: Novig Coins and Novig Cash. Novig Coins are used to play for fun and test new trading strategies, whereas Novig Cash can be played to redeem real cash prizes. Novig is available now on iOS with our Android release coming soon. All new users get 1,000 Novig Coins and 5 Novig Cash preloaded to their wallet to start trading. We currently offer moneyline, spread, total markets, and player props in NFL, NBA, WNBA, NCAAF, NCAAB, and MLB. In the coming months, we plan to expand our offerings to include parlays, SGPs, futures, more sports, and a web-based trading interface. Download our app here . Join our Discord server here to connect with other members of the Novig community and find counterparties to trade directly against at true “no vig” odds. The more users we have in our community, the stronger the exchange becomes, so I’d greatly appreciate it if you could help spread the word and get others to join the Novig movement. It’s high time for a more profitable, social, and efficient sports prediction market. We hope to see you on the market today, and good luck this season! Novig Cash and Coins mode displayed ‍

title: Bridging strategy with the business and technology needs of our clients’ operations
summary: Every year, we conduct Voice of Our Clients (VOC) interviews to discover and share the top industry trends and business and IT priorities across the industries we serve. title: Sponsoring the IEEE IUS 2025
body_text: Discover Our Ultrasonic Solutions for the Medical & Industrial Markets CTS will sponsor and attend the annual IEEE International Ultrasonics Symposium (IUS), held on 15 - 18 September 2025 in Utrecht, Netherlands. This year marks the 62nd installment of the ultrasound-focused conference where experts from the industry gather to discuss the latest developments in the field of ultrasonic technology, and CTS will participate with representatives from both our R&D and sales divisions. The IEEE IUS 2025 features a tightly-packed schedule of plenary talks, courses, lectures, poster presentations and more. Registration for this industry-leading conference is still open, so be sure to secure your spot now: IUS 2025 Program CTS at IEEE IUS 2025 In between the IEEE IUS schedule sessions, attendees can explore the ultrasonic solutions of select exhibitors. The CTS delegation can be found by booth #2 where we are displaying a range of our ultrasound-generating piezoelectric transducers, sensors and components. From application-optimized single crystal, PZT and lead-free materials to standard and custom-shaped piezoelectric components as well as ready-made transducer and sensor assemblies, we can devise a solution, guaranteed to meet the demands of your ultrasound technology. Stop by, and let's discuss how we might work together on a future project.
